positive_snippets:
Excellent location near the Metro, malls, and major attractions. Deluxe and Super Deluxe rooms were spacious, well-furnished, and comfortable, though the Single Rooms were tiny and in dire need for better upkeep. Staff were friendly and helpful. The breakfast lounge was located in the basement and had a couple of items, though tea/coffee was good.
WiFi and Hot water available.
Overall, a reliable and convenient stay.

Clean and well ventilated rooms at competitive price. The receptionist was helpful and breakfast was made available timely. The washroom is spacious and clean. The hotel is very close to metro station.
The staff were really helpful and the location was perfect. The rooms and bathroom could be better maintained, but overall it was a good stay.
negative_snippets: Very arrogant person at the reception. Doesn't know how to speak to the customer. He only believed in saying one thing, that look for some other hotel when we tried to understand the things for bulk booking. Staff should have courtesy to speak nicely to the customers. We are paying for the stay, so you gotta behave properly. And your rooms are not worth the money you are demanding plus your attitude. Will never recommend this to anyone.
